name: Melinda Magyar
bio:
Melinda began her career in software development before joining Magic Hat in Tokyo, where she transitioned into the world of Apple device management. Today, she works closely with customers to support their Apple environments while also developing solutions focused on automation, integration, and security.

She enjoys solving complex technical problems, improving workflows, and creating practical tools that make everyday work smoother and more efficient. Outside of work, she enjoys reading, exploring cafés and bookstores, spending time with cats, and staying active.
